competing_explanation: The single-study result could be unrepresentative if the chamber had unlogged excursions, but A6's 24/7 calibrated log shows only two sub-1C auto-recovered excursions, weakening this alternative.
hypothesis_statement: VERDICT: TRUE — the validated ICH Q1A(R2) 6-month stability study (A3) shows the only degradation product D-2 at 0.18% (well below the 0.5% threshold) and potency 99.1%, directly supporting that RX-441 is chemically stable at 25C/60% RH over 6 months with no degradation product above 0.5%.
predicted_outcome: Re-analysis of the same 6-month 25C/60% RH samples by the validated HPLC method would reproduce D-2 ≤0.5% and potency within 98-102% spec.
refutation_criterion: Any re-test showing a degradation product ≥0.5% or potency outside 98-102% at the 6-month timepoint would falsify the claim.
